newsitem.title: CHINA: China January industrial output up 10.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China January industrial output up 10.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's industrial output rose by 10.3 percent year-on-year in January to 150 billion yuan, the State Statistical Bureau said on Thursday.

State-owned enterprises and those with a majority state stake showed year-on-year growth of 6.8 percent in January, to 90.8 billion yuan, with the rate of growth little changed from a year ago, it said.
Output of collective industry rose by 9.5 percent to 43 billion yuan, falling by 8.2 percentage points, it said.
Output of private industry soared by 16.5 percent to 29.5 billion yuan, up by 3.4 percentage points, the bureau said.
Output of light industry rose by 10.5 percent to 62.8 billion yuan, while heavy industry grew by 10 percent to 87.2 billion yuan, the bureau said.

Production of durable consumer goods accelerated, with output of colour televisions, refrigerators and air conditioners growing by 13-19 percent while output of washing machines increased by 30.8 percent and cameras by 49.8 percent.
Output of primary energy products grew by 2.0 percent, with output of coal at 109 million tonnes, up by 0.6 percent.
Steel production was 6.899 million tonnes, up by 5.3 percent. Ethylene output rose 15.8 percent, the bureau said.
China's industrial output rose by 13.1 percent in 1996.
